title: Three mornings above Ukhrul
caption: Three mornings on the ridge above Ukhrul, walked with the guides who know it. Cold at dawn, warm by nine, and a village lunch in between. Plan the route before you go, the road from Imphal takes longer than the map suggests.
disclosure: Paid partnership with Manipur Tourism (prototype campaign)

title: Valley to hills in one afternoon
caption: You leave the Imphal valley in the afternoon and arrive somewhere fifteen degrees cooler. This is what the eastern hills look like when you stop treating them as a day trip.
disclosure: Paid partnership with Manipur Tourism (prototype campaign)

title: One night, one household
caption: A village homestay in the eastern hills is not a hotel with a view. It is somebody home. Book through a local host, eat what the family eats, and ask before you photograph.
disclosure: Paid partnership with Manipur Tourism (prototype campaign)

title: Kangla in four layers
caption: The same ground was a ceremonial centre, a garrison and then a heritage site again in 2004. Four layers, one walk.
disclosure: Paid partnership with Manipur Tourism (prototype campaign)

title: What the Kangla Sha are
caption: Everyone photographs them. Fewer people know what they are or where they stand in the approach.
disclosure: Paid partnership with Manipur Tourism (prototype campaign)
